name: Oracle Anchorite
body:
Like all oracles, anchorites serve an entire pantheon. However, unlike most other oracles, an anchorite hears the titans rather than the gods. Anchorites gain great spiritual awareness, yet they receive few clear answers from the defeated and scattered titans.

Mortification

Anchorites suffer from a self-imposed mortification of the flesh, seeking to understand the wounds wrought upon the Scarred Lands themselves. Anchorites must select the wasting oracle’s curse.

Solitude

Anchorites lose Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (planes) as class skills and gain Knowledge (nature) and Survival.

Child of the World (Su)

At 3rd level, the anchorite becomes immune to the dangers of harsh weather or environmental extremes, be they natural or magical. He is always under the effect of endure elements. If this effect is dispelled, he can activate it again the following round as a free action.

This ability replaces the revelation gained at 3rd level.
